achievement_title_map.json.use: Independent agreement check for all 208 title-linked rows.

method.evaluation: File-backed instruction and lookup-table evaluation for every sheet achievement ID; no target execution.
method.completion: An ordinal is proven only when <1024 and inverse(ordinal) equals that achievement. Otherwise ordinal is null and native evidence is retained.

default_zero.meaning: Native zero is ambiguous: inverse(0) returns achievement 100, which owns ordinal 0.

method.coverage: All 746 unique row IDs, sorted numerically. Neither sheet order nor reward values supply an ordinal.
method.sheet_ids_encoding: ASCII JSON array of sorted integer IDs with separators comma and colon, without whitespace or newline.
